description: Sites 2G, 3G, 4G - Pyrénées Atlantiques - Mon réseau mobile is a dataset listed in Open-Data La Fibre64 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ARCEP. Ce jeu de données recense et localise la dernière version des antennes mobiles des quatre opérateurs et la disponibilité des différentes technologies (2G, 3G, 4G) sur ces sites en France Métropolitaine et Outre-Mer. Attention, des erreurs ont été détectés sur les identifiants des sites (id sous forme E+XX) Enrichissement ajout des hiérarchies administratives. Coverage: Pyrénées-Atlantiques. The portal files it under Aménagement numérique. Its keywords are territoire, amenagement, telephone, mobile, voix, data. The portal shows 103,035 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-02-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open License v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/open-licence.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-lafibre64-fr-portal.
